name: brazil-einvoice
description: Prepare and review Brazilian electronic invoice working papers for 2026. Covers NF-e, NFC-e and national NFS-e routing, authorisation, XML groups, invoice keys, certificates, events, rejection diagnosis, records and downstream tax handoffs. Separates legal IBS/CBS duties from model-specific technical releases, testing and production dates, including enacted later changes. Trigger on nota fiscal, NF-e 55, NFC-e 65, NFS-e, CT-e, SEFAZ, XML, DANFE, cancellation, CC-e, IBS/CBS fields,2025.002, CNPJ alfanumérico or invoice rejection. Retains transport and other fiscal-document routing without treating all models as NF-e 4.00. State penalties, complete executable schemas and unsupported provider claims remain explicit gaps; invoice evidence does not itself establish a tax credit or replace the tax return.
